### Outdoor Holding Company Increases Aggregate Share Repurchase Authorization to $35 Million and Extends Program Through July 4, 2027


October 22, 2026


**Dallas, Texas, Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --** Outdoor Holding Company (Nasdaq: POWW, POWWP) (“OHC,” “we,” “us,” “our” or the “Company”), the owner of[GunBroker.com](http://gunbroker.com/) , the largest online marketplace dedicated to firearms, hunting, shooting and related products, today announced that its Board of Directors (the “Board”) approved an amendment to the Company’s share repurchase program that increases the aggregate repurchase authorization from $15 million to $35 million and extends the program by six months, through July 4, 2027. The $35 million authorization includes all repurchases made since the program was launched in January 2026 and represents a $20 million increase over the prior authorization.


As of September 30, 2026, the Company had repurchased approximately $8.4 million of its common stock under the program, excluding commissions and fees, leaving approximately $6.6 million available under the prior authorization. Except as described above, the terms of the program are unchanged.


“The Board’s decision to more than double the repurchase authorization reflects our confidence in the durability of GunBroker’s cash generation and our belief that our shares represent an attractive use of capital at current prices,” said Steve Urvan, Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer of the Company. “We have been a consistent and disciplined buyer of our stock since the program launched in January, and the strength of our balance sheet allows us to continue returning capital to shareholders from free cash flow while preserving the ability to continue investing in the platform and preserving the flexibility to pursue strategic opportunities. Allocating capital to its highest and best use is central to how we run the Company.”


Repurchases under the program may be made from time to time, in management’s discretion and within the limits of the Board’s authorization, through a variety of methods, including open market purchases, privately negotiated transactions, and other means in accordance with federal securities laws, including pursuant to one or more Rule 10b5-1 trading plans. The timing, volume, and value of any repurchases will be determined based on factors including market conditions, the Company’s liquidity and capital needs, and other factors deemed relevant by management.


Repurchases will be funded from existing cash balances, future operating cash flows or other legally available funds and remain subject to applicable law, the Company’s insider trading policy, applicable trading-window restrictions, and debt covenants and other contractual restrictions. The Board’s authorization does not itself amend any existing Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. The program does not obligate the Company to repurchase any particular number of shares and may be modified, suspended, or terminated at any time at the discretion of the Board or management.


**About Outdoor Holding Company**


Outdoor Holding Company is the publicly traded parent and operator of GunBroker.com, the largest online marketplace dedicated to firearms, hunting, shooting and related products. Third-party sellers list items on the site and federal and state laws govern the sale of firearms and other restricted items. Firearms sold through the marketplace are transferred through federally licensed firearms dealers in accordance with applicable law. Launched in 1999, the[GunBroker.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=yxLq_KbE1rFr9kWC9yiUv2WDrwqH85YAinUEG4ZzDtm-TF-sMWkRcdM4WXRBkvBBOwc16sG0eW4336m5oxKsBg==) website is an informative, secure and safe way to buy and sell firearms, ammunition, shooting accessories and outdoor gear online. GunBroker promotes responsible ownership of guns and firearms. For more information, visit:[www.gunbroker.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=z6RPmfbXCl5G-Cg8RPbaIPPS9p1C8QZxa-PUuI7TZb3EjJ8UBHEXh_joci4beNHTvH-HIQGqWfuLr1YWdDvkHLI4jvwNPmTiAjXPjy0KxjQ=) .
